UC-153.en: Your browser opens for {name} after {other}'s sign-in.
UC-153.hi: {other} का साइन इन पूरा होते ही {name} के लिए आपका ब्राउज़र खुलेगा।
UC-153.hi_by: app track (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-153.note: a plan's line, its download done while the other plan's sign-in is under way: sign-ins go one at a time, and its browser opens by itself after (orchestrator's decision, parallel installs)

UC-230.en: Sign-in cancelled. {name} is still downloading; sign in when it's ready.
UC-230.hi: साइन-इन रद्द हुआ। {name} अभी डाउनलोड हो रहा है; तैयार होने पर साइन इन करें।
UC-230.hi_by: app track (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-230.note: under a plan's download line, once its waiting sign-in is cancelled: desktop drops only the sign-in and the download carries on, so the row says so and loses its Cancel until the download ends (parallel installs, Mac proof)
